question: What exciting new color do you get when you mix Yellow and Blue paint? 🎨
explanation: Awesome! When you explore and mix yellow and blue together, it magically turns into green! 🟢
hint: It is the color of grass and leaves.

question: What happens when you mix Red and Yellow paint together? 🖌️
explanation: Super! Red and yellow mix together to make a bright, sunny orange! 🟠
hint: It is the color of a juicy fruit.

question: If you mix Red and Blue, what beautiful color will you discover? ✨
explanation: Great job! Red and blue are special colors that make purple when they hug each other! 🟣
hint: It is the color of a yummy grape.

question: What color do you get if you add a lot of White to Red paint? 🍓
explanation: Awesome! White makes colors lighter, so red turns into a soft pink! 🌸
hint: It is the color of bubblegum.

question: How does a cotton ball feel when you touch it? ☁️
explanation: Super! Cotton is very soft and fluffy, just like a little cloud! ☁️
hint: It feels like your favorite blanket.

question: If you rub your hand on sandpaper, how does it feel? 🛠️
explanation: Great job! Sandpaper is bumpy and scratchy, so we say it feels rough! 🌵
hint: It feels a bit like a cat's tongue.

question: What happens if you put a leaf under paper and color over it with a crayon? 🍃
explanation: Awesome! You can see the pattern of the leaf appear on the paper. This is called a leaf rubbing! 🖍️
hint: The lines of the leaf show up like magic.

question: What fun tool can you use to paint without a brush? 🖐️
explanation: Super! Finger painting is a super fun way to explore art and feel the slippery paint! 🎨
hint: They are right at the end of your hands.

question: How does wet clay feel when you squish it in your hands? 🏺
explanation: Great job! Wet clay is so fun to explore because it is soft, wet, and very squishy! 🏺
hint: You can mold it like dough.

question: What sound do you hear when you crumple a piece of paper? 📄
explanation: Awesome! When you squeeze paper, it makes a fun crinkly and crunchy sound! 📄
hint: It sounds like walking on dry leaves.

question: What can you put inside a plastic bottle to make a loud shaker instrument? 🍼
explanation: Super! Hard pebbles hit the plastic and make a loud shaking sound! 🪨
hint: They are small, hard stones.

question: If you tap two wooden sticks together, what do they make? 🪵
explanation: Great job! Exploring with sticks makes a fun 'clack-clack' wooden sound! 🪵
hint: It is a sound, not a picture.

question: What happens if you use a sponge to put paint on paper? 🧽
explanation: Awesome! A sponge makes cool, bumpy shapes on the paper. We call it sponge stamping! 🧽
hint: It leaves a bumpy print behind.

question: What vegetable can we cut in half and use to stamp paint? 🥔
explanation: Super! A cut potato is flat and perfect for stamping cool shapes in paint! 🥔
hint: It is brown on the outside and makes yummy chips.

question: How do you make a piece of art by tearing paper into small pieces? ✂️
explanation: Great job! Sticking torn pieces of paper together to make a picture is called a collage! 🖼️
hint: It starts with a 'C'.

question: What cool art can you make using an old toothbrush and paint? 🪥
explanation: Awesome! You can rub the bristles of a toothbrush to spray tiny dots of splatter paint! 🎨
hint: It makes tiny dots everywhere.

question: What happens if you blow watercolor paint with a drinking straw? 🥤
explanation: Super! The air pushes the wet paint around to make crazy, beautiful lines! 🎨
hint: The air makes the paint move.

question: What material is fun to dip in paint and drag across your paper? 🧶
explanation: Great job! A string leaves long, wiggly, and curvy lines on your paper! 🧶
hint: It is long and soft like thread.

question: How does a feather feel when you brush it on your arm? 🪶
explanation: Awesome! Feathers are super light and feel very soft and tickly on our skin! 🪶
hint: It makes you want to giggle.

question: What cool texture does bubble wrap have? 🫧
explanation: Super! Bubble wrap is full of little air pockets, so it feels very bumpy and fun to pop! 🫧
hint: It has little round lumps on it.

question: What sound does a glass make when you gently tap it with a metal spoon? 🥄
explanation: Great job! Metal tapping on glass makes a beautiful, high 'ting' sound like a tiny bell! 🎶
hint: It sounds like a tiny bell ringing.

question: What can you draw with on the sidewalk outside? 🛣️
explanation: Awesome! Sidewalk chalk is thick and perfect for drawing big art on the ground outside! 🖍️
hint: It washes away when it rains.

question: What can you mix with paint to make your painting feel rough and bumpy? 🏖️
explanation: Super! Mixing sand into paint gives your art a super cool, rough texture! 🏖️
hint: You find this at the beach.

question: If you look closely at a tree trunk, what texture do you see? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Tree bark protects the tree, so it is very rough, hard, and bumpy! 🪵
hint: It is not smooth at all.

question: When you put a coin under paper and color it, what appears? 🪙
explanation: Awesome! The shapes from the coin magically appear on your paper! 🪙
hint: It is a rubbing, just like with a leaf.

question: If you mix Black and White paint, what new color is made? 🦓
explanation: Super! Black and white are special, and together they make the color grey! 🐘
hint: It is the color of an elephant.

question: What do you explore when you use a magnifying glass? 🔍
explanation: Great job! A magnifying glass helps us explore and see super tiny details in art and nature! 🔍
hint: It makes small things look bigger.

question: What can you make on a wall using your hands and a flashlight? 🔦
explanation: Awesome! Your hands block the light to make cool shadow animals on the wall! 👤
hint: It is dark and follows you in the sun.

question: What fun toy can you make using an empty brown paper bag? 🛍️
explanation: Super! You can draw a face on the bag and put it on your hand to make a puppet! 🎭
hint: You can make it talk with your hand.

question: What color are most dry leaves that fall in Autumn? 🍂
explanation: Great job! Leaves change to beautiful brown, yellow, and orange colors in the Fall! 🍂
hint: They match the color of dirt.

question: Which of these is a Primary Color? 🔴
explanation: Awesome! Red is a primary color. We use it to mix and make other colors! 🔴
hint: It is the color of an apple.

question: Which of these is another Primary Color? 🔵
explanation: Super! Blue is a primary color. It is a very important color for mixing! 🔵
hint: It is the color of the sky.

question: What is the third Primary Color? 🟡
explanation: Great job! Yellow is the third primary color, just like the bright sun! 🟡
hint: It is the color of a banana.

question: What tool helps you spread liquid paint on paper? 🖌️
explanation: Awesome! A paintbrush has soft bristles to hold the paint and brush it on paper! 🖌️
hint: It has bristles at the end.

question: What do we use to safely cut paper into shapes? ✂️
explanation: Super! Scissors help us explore by cutting paper into any shape we want! ✂️
hint: They have two handles to squeeze.

question: What is the best material for sticking two pieces of paper together? 🧴
explanation: Great job! Glue is sticky and perfect for building and making collages! 🧴
hint: It is very sticky.

question: If you tap a large drum with your hand, what sound does it make? 🥁
explanation: Awesome! Tapping a drum makes a low, loud 'boom boom' rhythm! 🥁
hint: It is a deep, loud sound.

question: What art can you create with empty cardboard boxes? 📦
explanation: Super! Exploring with empty boxes lets you build big forts and castles! 🏰
hint: You can build something big to hide inside.

question: What happens when you mix all your paint colors together? 🎨
explanation: Great job! If you mix too many colors, they explore together to become a muddy brown or grey! 🟤
hint: It looks like the color of dirt.

question: What shape is the sun when we draw it in the sky? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! The sun is a big, beautiful round circle in the sky! ☀️
hint: It has no corners at all.

question: How do you feel a rock you find in the garden? 🪨
explanation: Super! Rocks in the garden are very hard and usually feel cool to touch! 🪨
hint: You cannot squish it.

question: What cool art uses dry pasta to make a picture? 🍝
explanation: Great job! You can glue macaroni to paper and paint it to make beautiful art! 🍝
hint: It is a type of food.

question: If you add black paint to a color, what happens to it? 🕶️
explanation: Awesome! Black paint is very strong and makes any color much darker! 🌑
hint: It makes it look more like the night.

question: What happens if you spill lots of water on thin paper? 💧
explanation: Super! Water makes paper very soft, and it can tear easily, so be gentle! 📄
hint: It gets very weak and soft.

question: What fun art involves folding a piece of paper many times? 🦢
explanation: Great job! Exploring paper folding to make shapes like birds and boats is called Origami! 🦢
hint: It is a special word that starts with 'O'.

question: What sound do you make when you clap your hands together? 👏
explanation: Awesome! Clapping your hands makes a wonderful rhythm and beat for music! 👏
hint: It is a loud, happy sound.

question: If you throw a small pebble into a puddle, what sound does it make? 💧
explanation: Super! Water makes a fun splashing sound when something drops into it! 💦
hint: Water flies up in the air.

question: What tape can you put on paper, paint over, and pull off to leave white lines? 🤍
explanation: Great job! This is called Tape Art! The tape protects the paper from the paint! 🤍
hint: You use it to wrap gifts.

question: When you draw a face, what part do you draw to show a big smile? 👄
explanation: Awesome! The mouth curves up to show a beautiful, happy smile in your art! 👄
hint: It is below the nose.

question: What is the very best part about exploring art and making new things? 🎉
explanation: Super! Art is all about exploring, trying new things, and having lots of fun! 🎉
hint: It makes you smile and laugh.
